scientific_integrity: Exact formal-power-series proof; finite rational-arithmetic checks independently reconstructed. The theorem is about full absorption at one endpoint, one reflecting wall and homogeneous transition probabilities; its priority is provisional pending independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Only one absorbing right endpoint and one left reflecting endpoint
Strictly positive forward and backtrack probabilities with direction-retaining laziness
No claims for partially absorbing or interior targets, or two reflecting walls
No independent external verification or exhaustive prior-art certification
title: All-time stochastic ordering of bouncing and bunching reflection in persistent lattice search
